thread:
Priya: ok team, quick pre-shift note — I'm taking primary for the next 8h. Incoming handover: two low-sev pagers last night around kv cache warmup, and a lingering spike in 95th latency for /v1/generate in us-west that briefly breached our SLOs. I put links below. I'll be primary for the morning window, @Sam you cool to cover secondary until 18:00 UTC?

oncall-bot: INCIDENTS SUMMARY — Open: 1. INC-2026 (kv-cache-thrash) — triggered 02:13 UTC, escalated to oncall. 2. ALERT-881 (p95 /v1/generate us-west) — intermittent since 03:40 UTC. See: https://infra.redwood/runbooks/incidents

Sam: yep I can do secondary. Priya — any immediate mitigations you want me to own if the pager fires?

Priya: thanks. If INC-2026 fires again, priority is: 1) scale the kvcache pods (runbook step) 2) toggle prefix-caching to bypass (short term) 3) invoke fallback routing to model-variant-lowmem if GPU pressure looks high. Quick commands below. Also watch for client retries multiplying requests.

Jordan: adding the runbook links — KV cache playbook: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash and Fallback routing: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/model-fallback. Both have the exact commands we'll use.

Molly: FYI customer-impact note — we saw a small number of 429s from heavy prefix churn for two enterprise tenants (acct: ACME_CO, ACCT-998). Sat has already been notified via the status page but please double-check post-mitigation.

Priya: copy. If p95 is > SLO for > 5m, escalate to infra-sre and open a p95-triage channel. For now, our short checklist: 1) check queue depth 2) bump kvcache replicas 3) enable model-fallback 4) drain any noisy workers.

Sam: got it. commands I'll run (copy/paste):

```
# scale kvcache deployment
kubectl -n redwood scale deploy/kvcache --replicas=6
# toggle prefix-caching (feature flag)
redctl feature-set prefix_cache enabled=false --env production
# route to fallback model
redctl route set /v1/generate model-variant-lowmem --weight 100 --reason "fallback during pressure"
```

Jordan: small note — after scaling, watch socket backlog and GC on workers. If CPU on workers spikes, we should revert scaling and instead enable model-fallback; aggressive scaling sometimes makes GC worse.

Priya: thanks. Also quick `curl` checks for health/status: 
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health | jq .components.kvcache
curl -sS "https://api.redwood.internal/metrics?q=p95%5B%2Fv1%2Fgenerate%5D" | jq .values[-1]
```

oncall-bot: NOTE: Runbook quicklinks pinned: KV cache playbook | Fallback routing | Rollback runbook. Auto-escalation set to 10m for INC-2026.

Molly: if you need a fast rollback of the recent routing change, use: `redctl rollout undo router-config --to-revision=HEAD~1` — that usually clears misrouting in ~30s. Also check the dashboard: https://console.redwood/redwood/ops/route-health

Sam: ACK. Taking secondary. I'll monitor channels and handle immediate pagers. Priya — want me to call you if I see >2x error-rate?

Priya: pls call if >2x or any customer reports after mitigation. If we get sustained traffic spike, we'll enable burst capacity on Dedicated (tickets: DED-501) — Jordan, you have the dedicated control creds right?

Jordan: yes I do. I can enable burst capacity and pin a canary model for routing. I'll only do that after we try kvcache scaling and fallback.

Priya: perfect. One more quick pointer for anyone stepping in later: common quick fixes are in-line at the top of the kv-cache runbook — commands for scaling, prefix toggles, and a kb section for diagnosing client retry storms. If you need automated mitigations: incident automation can perform scale+toggle but requires a 2-person ack to run (safety).

Sam: noted. I'll keep a checklist in the thread live if something changes.

Molly: last bit — postmortem threshold: if INC-2026 causes >5m customer impact or >3% global error-rate, flag for postmortem and tag the ticket with `pm-required`.

Priya: thanks all. Handshake complete — primary=Priya, secondary=Sam, escalation chain: Priya -> Jordan -> infra-sre. Quick reference links: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash , https://redwood.infra/runbooks/model-fallback , https://redwood.infra/runbooks/rollbacks. I'll update status page if we take any actions.

oncall-bot: SHIFT NOTE: Primary set to Priya until 2026-09-03T18:00:00Z. Secondary: Sam. Automated monitoring alerts preserved.

Sam: logging into the dashboards now. ping me here if anything noisy. :thumbsup:
